findings.text: They had passed each other with the whole hill between.
findings.subject: They (grammatically the nearest plural is 'the two of them', i.e. the Pass road and the drove cut)
findings.realAgent: Sylvanas's party riding down the Pass road and the Millhaven dead walking up the cut
findings.reason: Actor omitted or demoted. The paragraph before ends on the two routes ('the two of them further and further apart the higher they went'), so 'They' parses as the roads. Diverging roads cannot 'pass each other' as an event, so the reader has to re-parse to find the real actors, the riders and the dead, who are never named in the sentence. Putting the actors in subject position keeps the meaning and sets up the mage's later 'We were the whole hill away.'
findings.suggestedFix: She and the dead had passed each other with the whole hill between.
